warhead.provenance: 650 lb HE = 294.8 kg per OOB (csg-us-mk48-navy, A). Explosive/case split, lethal radius, and damage are engineering-estimate surrogates for a heavyweight torpedo warhead against a ship hull, calibrated higher than aircraft-delivered warheads of similar total mass because underwater/keel-breaking damage mechanisms are more effective per kg.

fuze.provenance: No public fuze timing data; engineering-estimate contact/magnetic-influence fuze typical of a heavyweight anti-ship/anti-submarine torpedo.

_real_world.role: Heavyweight torpedo, submarine-launched via torpedo tube
_real_world.guidance_real: Wire-guided; active/passive acoustic homing; CBASS sonar (Mod 7); re-attack capability
_real_world.mount_mapping: none — no NavalWeaponType exists for torpedoes; placed only in _real_world.weapon_inventory (Virginia-class torpedo room capacity ~25 weapons)

warhead.type.note: blast: no public detonation-mechanism detail beyond HE fill mass; generic blast is the nearest real engine-recognized warhead type for an underwater HE torpedo warhead

warhead.provenance.note: legacy inline provenance-note scaffold string, superseded by this structured _provenance.parameters block; retained as descriptive metadata, not a runtime scalar

fuze.provenance.note: legacy inline provenance-note scaffold string, superseded by this structured _provenance.parameters block; retained as descriptive metadata, not a runtime scalar

max_flight_time_s.note: no public endurance figure; engineering estimate derived from the ~20-27 nmi Tier C-est range at the 28.3 m/s used speed (range/speed), rounded to 2500s

flight_model.max_speed.note: official only states >28 kt (A, lower bound); Tier C estimates 55-65 kt conflict; used 55 kt = 28.3 m/s midpoint-low estimate

flight_model.max_g.note: no public maneuver-load figure; low value consistent with a heavyweight torpedo's hydrodynamic turn limits versus an airframe missile

flight_model.max_turn_rate.note: no public figure; engineering estimate for a wire-guided heavyweight torpedo's rudder-limited turn rate

guidance.type.note: wire-guided with active/passive acoustic homing; modeled as PassiveAcoustic for the terminal homing mode. The engine's guidance.type loader only recognizes ActiveRadar/Radar or IR/Infrared as a seeker_type, so acoustic homing has no matching engine category. This record has no functional mount anyway (mechanism gap, torpedo), so the field is descriptive metadata only

guidance.active_seek_range.note: no public CBASS active-sonar acquisition range; engineering estimate typical of a heavyweight-torpedo active acoustic seeker

guidance.pn_los_rate_source.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, not a sourced weapon characteristic; record has no functional mount regardless

guidance.target_kinematics_estimator.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, same basis as pn_los_rate_source

guidance.capture_guidance_mode.note: disabled: no terminal capture-guidance submode is modeled for this record's mechanism-gap weapon

guidance.target_tracker_alpha.note: standard alpha-beta-gamma tracker filter constant, engine convention shared across missile records, not weapon-specific

guidance.target_tracker_beta.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.target_tracker_gamma.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.nav_gain.note: proportional-navigation gain scaffold; no public guidance-law constant, set low consistent with a torpedo's slower closing-speed homing loop

guidance.apn_target_accel_gain.note: augmented-PN target-acceleration compensation gain scaffold, not sourced per-weapon

guidance.autopilot_tau_s.note: autopilot response time-constant scaffold; set slower than an airframe missile, consistent with a torpedo's hydrodynamic control response

guidance.max_accel_response_g_per_s.note: autopilot response-rate scaffold; set low consistent with a torpedo's control-surface response versus an airframe missile

warhead.lethal_radius.note: engineering-estimate surrogate for a heavyweight torpedo warhead against a ship hull, no sourced lethal-radius figure

warhead.damage.note: engineering-estimate surrogate, calibrated higher than aircraft-delivered warheads of similar mass because underwater/keel-breaking damage mechanisms are more effective per kg

warhead.explosive_mass_kg.note: engineering-estimate HE/case split of the sourced 294.8 kg total warhead mass, no public split figure

warhead.projection_radius_fraction.note: copied from the weapons/air_to_air/aim_120c.json blast-fragmentation projection-geometry template, scaled for a blast-only underwater warhead

warhead.projection_max_radius_m.note: copied/scaled from the aim_120c.json template pattern for this warhead's larger lethal_radius

warhead.projection_max_projected_hitboxe.note: copied from the aim_120c.json template pattern

fuze.type.note: no public fuze timing data; contact fuze is the nearest real engine-recognized fuze family for a heavyweight torpedo's contact/magnetic-influence exploder, per the loader's 4-value fuze.type vocabulary

fuze.trigger_radius_m.note: 0.0 consistent with a contact-fuze trigger radius; no public influence-fuze standoff distance

fuze.delay_s.note: no public fuze timing data; engineering-estimate scaffold typical of a contact/magnetic-influence exploder

fuze.reliability.note: no public reliability figure; engineering-estimate scaffold value

modeling_notes: No functional mount exists (mechanism gap, torpedo); content-only for _real_world.weapon_inventory. Official figures are explicit lower bounds only per OOB R17; used conservative low-end Tier C-est for speed rather than the higher 65 kt claim.
